component-metadata.author: knimeuser
component-metadata.description:
The metanode is used for filtering upregulated and downregulated proteins after performing a statistical test (e. g. LIMMA). The input data table should contain columns containing p-values (adjusted p-values) and logFC values. First output port contains only upregulated proteins, second one only downregulated proteins, the third combined list of down and upregulated proteins and the fourth output port contains the original dataset with appended column with the expression change information. All lists but the last one are sorted (up - descending; down and down+up - ascending).
You can also limit the generated up/down lists; the list will be shortened leaving the cases with higher (up) or lower (down) logFC values.
In case you want to select the candidates only based on the log fold change value, check the appropriate check box to ignore the P value column.
